title: Deskbound | Kelly Starrett | Talks at Google
summary: Kelly Starrett's Talks at Google presentation on staying healthy while desk bound, mixing anatomy and practical mobility advice. It shows how to set up a desk and sit and move to avoid pain.
why: Often the first thing suggested to HN programmers asking about posture and back pain.
